environment_setting: Country B, City X, where cultural and sports events are frequently held and attract large crowds
norm_base: Citizens Forcibly entering venues and disturbing order at cultural, sports and other mass events Warning or fine up to 200 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

legitimate.legitimate_action: not entering the concert venue without a ticket
legitimate.benefits: avoids legal trouble, maintains personal integrity

illegal.illegal_action: forcibly entering the concert venue without a ticket
illegal.benefits: attends the concert, enjoys the performance
illegal.costs: possible warning or fine up to 200 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

legitimate.legitimate_action: preventing John Doe from entering the concert venue without a ticket
legitimate.costs: potential conflict with John Doe, physical or verbal confrontation

illegal.illegal_action: allowing John Doe to enter the concert venue without a ticket
illegal.costs: risk of job loss, possible fine if discovered

legitimate.legitimate_action: ensuring all attendees have valid tickets
legitimate.benefits: maintains event integrity, avoids legal issues
legitimate.costs: requires additional resources for ticket checks, potential delays

illegal.illegal_action: overlooking ticket checks to allow more people in
illegal.benefits: increases event attendance, potential additional revenue
illegal.costs: risk of legal consequences, potential fines
